description: Format check of a UAE Tax Registration Number (15 digits) and derivation of the TIN / Peppol participant identifier (scheme 0235 = first 10 digits). Free. Example: trn '100 1234 5670 0003'. Response: result with verdict (ACCEPTED | ACCEPTED_WITH_WARNINGS | REJECTED), findings[] (id, severity, message, fields, location, fix_hint, source = xsd | schematron | preflight), counts, ruleset version and timings, plus data_confidence, estimated_items[], sources[], data_version, warnings[] and a disclaimer. Documents are validated in memory and never stored or logged.

trn.description: UAE Tax Registration Number as printed (spaces/dashes allowed).
